# KaamGuide

> KaamGuide (https://igaf.me) publishes step-by-step guides in easy Roman Urdu for Pakistani government services. Fees, documents and processes are verified against official sources (DGIP, NADRA, FBR, excise departments). It is a private guidance website, not a government website.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://igaf.me)
- [All guides](https://igaf.me/guides)
- [About](https://igaf.me/about)
- [Contact](https://igaf.me/contact)
